physics: Early near-boundary high-recross confidence is often a fragile first thesis. If clock decay flips the executable edge to the opposite side, the old thesis was path noise; if it does not, the market is skipped and broad coverage is repaired from calmer geometry.
repair_rule: clean repair rows ranked by farthest boundary geometry
wait_rule: first same-market opposite-side row with seconds_to_close<=480, p>=0.50, executable raw edge>=0, max delay 480s
